title: ‘New!’ Badge in Application Launcher not cleared when Remember opened documents is disabled
line: Launching a newly installed app from the Application Launcher now removes its New! badge even when Recent Files history is turned off.
explanation: Since the launcher started relying on the activity manager to notice app launches, the New! badge was only cleared when kactivitymanagerd emitted ResourceScoreUpdated for the app. With 'Remember opened documents' set to 'Do not remember', the scoring plugin ignores launches, so the signal never comes and the badge stays until it expires after three days. The change factors the clearing code into RootModel::clearNewlyInstalledApp() and also calls it from AppEntry::run() when an app is launched from the menu, so launches from Kickoff/Kicker (lists, categories, favorites) clear the badge regardless of the history setting.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: clear the New! badge when launching an app from the menu

The badge was only cleared when the activity manager reported a new score
for the app, which never happens when history is disabled in the Recent
Files settings. Launching an app from the menu now clears it directly.

BUG: 506876

media.caption: Pure master, history set to 'Do not remember': the new app 'Zz New Test 2' shows New!
Pure master: after launching it from Kickoff and reopening, New! is still there
With the fix, same setting: the new app 'Zz New Test' shows New!
With the fix: after launching it from Kickoff and reopening, the badge and the Utilities dot are gone

reviews.text: Factoring out RootModel::clearNewlyInstalledApp() and calling it from AppEntry::run() cleanly handles direct menu clicks in Kickoff/Kicker when history tracking is disabled. However, as acknowledged in the notes and raised by Kai in comment #2, this still leaves the 'New!' badge stuck when launching a newly installed app from Kickoff's own search bar (RunnerModel), KRunner, the desktop, or the task manager with history off. In addition, clearNewlyInstalledApp() traverses the entire entry tree on every launch even when highlightNewlyInstalledApps is disabled, and its debug log still hardcodes '(resourceScore)'.
changes: Extend clearing beyond direct AppEntry::run() clicks so launches from Kickoff's own search results (and ideally KRunner/external launches via activation/startup feedback as Kai suggested in comment #2, keeping AppEntry::run() as fallback for StartupNotify=false apps) also clear the 'New!' badge when history is disabled.
Guard RootModel::clearNewlyInstalledApp() with an early return when `!m_highlightNewlyInstalledApps` to avoid walking the full app model tree on every launch when the feature is off.
Update the qCDebug message in RootModel::clearNewlyInstalledApp() so it does not log `(resourceScore)` when called from AppEntry::run().

reviews.text: The refactor is clean and correct as far as it goes: AppEntry::run() now clears the badge through RootModel::clearNewlyInstalledApp(), and the before/after screenshots prove it for a launch from Kickoff's category list. But the entry's own notes admit it only covers launches from the launcher's AppEntry lists. Launching from Kickoff's own search results (the most common way to start a newly installed app), KRunner, the desktop or the task manager still leaves the badge until it expires with history disabled. The reporter's 'does not disappear after running the app' and Kai's c2 both treat KRunner and the other launch paths as part of the problem, so with BUG: 506876 this would close the report while it is only partly fixed.
changes: Also clear the badge for application matches launched from the launcher's search (kicker RunnerModel/RunnerMatchesModel trigger of services/krunner_services matches, mapping the match to its storageId).

Cover launches outside the launcher (KRunner, desktop, task manager) with a launch signal that doesn't depend on activity tracking, e.g. startup feedback/KStartupInfo or an application-launched notification from KIO::ApplicationLauncherJob, as Kai suggested in c2; otherwise downgrade to CCBUG and keep the bug open.
Add before/after evidence for a Kickoff search-result launch and a KRunner launch with 'Do not remember' set.
